condition.expression: no_confirmed_short AND vin_present AND vcc_present AND en_present AND NOT switching_measured

next_steps.action: Probe the switching node (inductor input) on the affected channel.

measure.where: Inductor input pad for the affected channel
measure.expected: Square wave at the controller's switching frequency (typically 300-750 kHz for ALW bucks), swinging 0 to VIN.
measure.safety: ALW controllers are dual-channel; probe the right channel.

interpretations.then: Controller is switching. Proceed to check FB/output voltage.
Controller is not switching despite all conditions good. Likely dead. Verify soft-start/ILIM pins are not shorted before replacing.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need controller datasheet for switching frequency and channel assignment.
